title: OpenCode – Open source AI coding agent

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if AI could write code faster than you can type?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenCode is breaking onto Hacker News with 452 points and 204 comments — and it’s changing how we code.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that writes, debugs, and optimizes code in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses a unique dual-agent system — one for logic, one for creativity — to generate clean, efficient code.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers, startups, and indie hackers are already using it to speed up project timelines by 40%.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? OpenSource AI tools like OpenCode are democratizing high-level coding skills.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you tried using AI to write code yet?
